[[File:Blue_r3_anh.jpg|thumb|250px|Plastex was used to make the clear dome of [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]].]]
'''Plastex''' was a clear material. The domed head of [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series astromech droid]] was constructed of plastex.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> It could also be used to make envelopes,<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> and used in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] interiors.<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>

{{Substance-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Plastex was mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'' novel]] ([[1996]]) by [[Steve Perry]]. The novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]'' ([[2008]]) by [[Troy Denning]] mentioned there being a [[House of Plastex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in which figures were displayed.
